source_facts.fact: The selected current method-code path reads _iCVF2 and sets iCVFolds=2.
Inner method selection passes its training arrays to doCVedModelFit with the selected two folds and CVFoldInds=None.
The default caller invokes genCVFoldInds without shuffle arguments.
Unshuffled contiguous selection blocks have ceil(N/K) rows except the final tail; remaining rows train. The separate floor/remainder helper at lines 145–162 is not selected.
The CV path invokes prepareTrainingAndTestData with fold indices and explicit YType/ZType/missing marker.
Preparation slices folds before learning transforms and retains raw and scaled selection arrays separately.
Scaling uses a masked mean and sample SD ddof=1. Z-scoring also centers. Division is restricted to positive-SD dimensions; constant channels retain SD zero.

source_facts.source: Nature Neuroscience paper, Methods: Fourth dataset
source_facts.fact: The fourth dataset uses 2D cursor position and velocity, and a random 32-electrode subset with 77–99 single units across sessions. This does not reveal the selected electrode identities or original array-column order.

component_design.input: Authenticated, already-preprocessed outer-training rows in their declared original order; float64 finite continuous neural and behavior matrices.
explicit_choices: Canonical behavior positions then velocities with declared units
component_design.admitted_profile: Two inner folds; at least two training rows per fold; 77–99 neural channels and four behavior channels; no missing markers, discarded samples, external inputs, trial lists or shared train/selection rows.
component_design.operator_only: Selection behavior is returned as reference material. This API does not enforce access isolation, authenticate arrays or ensure causal inference.
component_design.source_not_history: The pinned current caller establishes an independently supportable source-default inner method. It does not establish the exact historical Figure 6 execution.
component_design.column_order_boundary: The enforced position_x, position_y, velocity_x, velocity_y order and these ID strings are an explicit caller-admitted representation, not recovered historical original-column order. The caller must establish and document the original-column mapping before input. This component does not reorder columns, infer electrode identity or authenticate the mapping; the source helpers themselves are dimension-general.

validation.private_source_parity: Seven generated controls passed once, including all 16 scaling-flag combinations and both inner folds against isolated pure author functions. No full author module, original data or model was imported.
validation.portable_controls: Five public generated controls were prepared after that execution. Their final source requires integration execution; the earlier pass is not claimed for their final bytes.

attribution: No author code, numerical source fixture, original data or model is vendored in this component. Source behavior is attributed above; the generated test fixture uses independently authored arithmetic.
